text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, how's that!
Surprised, Groove-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that surprised me.
Good grief, you really are reckless!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, pulling off reckless stunts
requires true skill in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wild and chaotic, curious about everything... and yet, never letting anyone get too close.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...At least for today, I wanted to beat you
and make you spit out how you really feel."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, I haven't given up.
If I am to walk my ideal path, it would hardly
do to remain defeated by you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Face me again without fail, Fine.
I'm sure your mind is already made up... but you still have time until the end, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Groove-san...
Yeah, I'll think about it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but this is a challenge for a rematch, right?
In that case, can I set a condition?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Once we're back at the academy, take me
to the ramen shop you think is the best, Groove!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you like is fine, Groove-san.
Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Understood, I'll give it some thought.
I'll find you the best ramen shop—one that'll overturn everything you've ever known.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that sounds promising♪
...If you're looking for shops, I'll come along with you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That completely defeats the purpose!
...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness! You have a call from your elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ! By elder sister, you mean—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Fine Motion's sister,
she's a legendary Umamusume active on the world stage.
I've only heard rumors about her, though...

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
They mentioned that they would like
to speak with Lady Air Groove, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really are Onee-sama's favorite, aren't you?
Groove-san—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, don't patch them through!
Tell them I've already gone home!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear...
Captain, I'm sorry, but could you please tell Groove that I can't speak with her?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, in that case,
they said 'hand over your Trainer'..."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "—Hiiie, are you the Trainer of my beauteous princess?"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘Frightened? What a shame,
I prefer those with a stronger spirit.
If you're frail, I'd have to hold back, wouldn't I?’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's older sister, whom I had never spoken to before...
had quite a unique personality.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘A bit anticlimactic, but fine.
I can still fulfill my objective.
Now, let's get down to business.’"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
“――Thank you.
I just really wanted to tell you that.”

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "You see, she had always been fulfilling my duties in my stead. As you can see, I was selfish and set my sights on racing early on."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"'She denies it and says it was her own choice, but...
I've felt guilty in my heart all this time.
That I was the one who locked that innocent child away in the castle.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"So seeing that child running freely
in Japan... made me feel relieved."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for letting her speak her true feelings, and for letting her run freely through the wide world."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "'From here on out as well,' please take care of her."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"What are you talking about?
Can I listen too?"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, is that a sweet little bird chirping?
Put Fine Motion on the line, please."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hello, dear sister? Thank you so much
for the passionate love letter the other day.
I was truly moved by it.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "It was hard putting my love for you into words... I finally finished writing this after running halfway around the globe."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of you, Onee-sama!
Then, were those spots spilled here and there sweat?
And here I thought it was black tea?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘They are tears of deep yearning, of course.
Though a bit of Assam tea might have gotten mixed in.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sisters' conversation continued after that
at their own peculiar pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And before heading back from Hokkaido to summer camp...
an unexpected incident occurred."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Fine-san!
Is it true that you're quitting racing!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Captain?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...I have confirmed it. It appears that word
of our meeting following our return to the country
has leaked out from somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...
Regardless, it is not something that can be concealed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once this year is over...
I will return to Ireland and fulfill my mission.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!
We won't be able to see Fine run anymore!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so very much
for all your support up until now."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly...
I have a request for everyone."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I really want you to see my final race.
I promise to keep your eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...No.
I absolutely want to carve my mark.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So, make sure you watch me.
Will you... keep your eyes on me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We will hold a press conference at a later date with more details.
Now then... if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Fine Motion's sincere feelings got through to them,
because the fans quietly saw her off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And once we returned to the camp lodge...
there was something I needed to tell her.
It was about our next target race."
choice_data_list: This might be our last race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: I've narrowed the candidate races down to four.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Considering the timing, the prestige of the race, and above all,
rivals that would allow her to genuinely enjoy racing, the choice was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
Mile Championship, and Arima Kinen—these four races.
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear your opinion.
I'd like to hear your opinion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Just asking, but I could run in every race, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's just... you want to decide which race you want to be your final one, in peak condition... right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Could you let me think about it for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please, give me one day.
I need to... make up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Will she end up making that decision all on her own again?
choice_data_list: (No, I'm sure it won't come to that)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing that,
I decided to leave it in her hands this once.
